title: Bounty Bars
description: Homemade coconut bars dipped in dark chocolate — a gooey coconut filling made with condensed milk, coated in bittersweet chocolate.

ingredients.text: 1 x 397g tin of sweetened condensed milk

steps: Mix the coconut and condensed milk into a thick paste. Cover and chill for 2 hours until hardened.
Dampen your palms and flatten the coconut filling into a rectangle around 1.3cm thick. Slice into bars. Chill for another hour.
Melt 250g of the dark chocolate. Allow to cool slightly, then tip on to a plate.
Dip the bars in chocolate, covering top and four sides. Place on a wire rack and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Melt remaining 50g chocolate and drizzle over the top of each bar for a glossy finish. Allow to set.
notes: Makes 14–16 bars. Per bar estimate. Work quickly — the filling can soften.
